comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. GitHub #645's design (mitcad#2415; opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/shell-sharp-reported-test.cmake): Body1 (F6.b0), a loft (Loft1 F6) cut to a slot with round ends (Extrude1 F9), its top edges rounded 2 mm (Fillet1 F10; the rounding along the slot's end is one B-spline surface with a crease, split there by the shell). A closed shell (no face removed): the geometry kernel's offset of the slot's end and of the loft's face below it intersect in three pieces, of which it kept the middle one only, and the offsets of those faces got no face; it failed at any thickness (OCCT port patch 2415).
The inside of the slot's round end and of the loft's face below it (no face before).
The wall: the body (91667.5 mm3) less its closed offset 2 mm in (68937.2 in the OCCT lab, Sharp and Rounded alike).

The report's shell (mitcad#2462): the loft's top F6:side(c2)#1 removed, Inside 2 mm, Sharp. Every face round the top (the 2 mm rounding) meets it tangentially, and the wall is no thicker than the rounding: the rounding's offset lies under the top all along and never meets it. It failed ('the offset faces do not close up'); now the wall ends in strips along the normal from the top's edges to their offsets (OCCT port patch 2462), named after the removed top. The volume: the geometry kernel's 18284.9 mm3 in the OCCT lab (case 2462-top-open-met-tangentially), Sharp and Rounded alike.
Rounded, as the report also asks: the same wall.
1 mm, Sharp: 9595.7 mm3 in the OCCT lab (Rounded 9595.6).
